name: Sodium Nitrate
summary: At Bael Modan, Sodium Nitrate helps the dwarves blast through the southern Barrens’ stone. Gann Stonespire seeks the chemical for charges against the fortress.

sections.title: Industrial Demolition
sections.body: Dwarven excavators at Bael Modan use Sodium Nitrate to break through the southern Barrens’ rock. The Bael'dun expedition entered the Stonespire tribe’s ancestral lands with earthmovers and blasting reagents. Riflemen, soldiers, and officers carry the chemical inside the excavation works and nearby fortress.

sections.title: Turnabout and Retribution
sections.body: Gann Stonespire watched the invaders after they devastated his tribe’s homeland and scavenged their engineering schematics. Unable to breach the defended keep with ordinary attacks, the exiled tauren turns their blasting supplies against them. He mixes looted Sodium Nitrate with nitroglycerin and wood pulp to make charges meant to shake Bael Modan’s foundations.

faq.q: What is Sodium Nitrate used for in the Barrens?
faq.answer: The Ironforge dwarves use Sodium Nitrate in explosives to blast rocky ground at their dig site. Gann Stonespire mixes it with nitroglycerin and wood pulp to make charges against Bael Modan.

faq.q: Where does Sodium Nitrate come from?
faq.answer: Dwarven forces stationed at Bael Modan in the southern Barrens carry Sodium Nitrate. Riflemen, soldiers, officers, and commanders such as Lord Cyrik Blackforge keep it on hand.

faq.q: Why does Gann Stonespire need this chemical?
aliases: why does gann want sodium nitrate
faq.answer: Gann Stonespire lost his ancestral village to the dwarven excavation. Without heavy siege equipment, he studied their schematics and set out to make charges that could break their fortified positions with their own supplies.

faq.q: Is Sodium Nitrate dangerous on its own?
faq.answer: On its own, sodium nitrate is an oxidizer and chemical salt, not an instant explosive. Mixed with a fuel source and shock-sensitive chemicals such as nitroglycerin, it becomes dangerous and volatile.

angles.text: Engineers recognize sodium nitrate, nitroglycerin, and wood pulp as the recipe for stabilized dynamite, the basis of Gann’s improvised charges.
As a tauren, Gann Stonespire turns to dwarven chemicals to strike back for the destruction of his ancestral territory.
